_comment: Agency routing registry — copy to clients.json (gitignored). Only needed in AGENCY mode (one instance routing across many client dashboards, like TechTower). A single-tenant client instance doesn't need this — it writes to its one tracker from client.json. Each to-do is routed to a client by matching the email domain / name alias below; pipeline + internal items go to internalBoard.

internalBoard.name: Your agency — internal & pipeline
internalBoard._titleField_note: Notion DBs differ in the name of their title column. The master/internal tracker uses 'Item'; the client v2 dashboards use 'Task'. W2 MUST write the to-do text into THIS field name for the target, or create fails.

clients.name: Example Prospect
clients._note: type:pipeline routes to internalBoard, not its own page.
